title: The Efficacy and Safety of Sildenafil Citrate Used in Combination With Intravenous Epoprostenol in PAH
brief_summary: Determination of the effects of sildenafil citrate and epoprostenol when used in combination in patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension caused by primary PAH, associated with connective tissue disease or following surgical repair of a congenital heart lesion

Exclusion Criteria:

* PH other than PAH
